items.question: Which deities continue the enumeration of tithi lords addressed to the goddess?
premises: The preceding verses introduce an enumeration of tithi lords.
Vahnir names fire as a member of this sequence.
Brahmā, Candraḥ, Śivaḥ, and Aditiḥ are listed as further members.
items.inference: The sequence of tithi lords continues with Fire, Brahmā, the Moon, Śiva, and Aditi.
uncertainties: The specific tithi assignments for each named deity are not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Fire, Brahmā, the Moon, Śiva, and Aditi.
